shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls

cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*; do echo $p $(node -p "require('./$p/package.json').version"); done

rg -n -A 12 "navigation\`" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@^7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname 2>&1 | tail -5 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout FooterItem 2>&1 | head -60

ls -la .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation -name "INDEX.md" -o -name "*.md" -path "*docs*" | head

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n -i -B2 -A15 "required setup|## Install|## Usage" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -80; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md

sed -n 354,400p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-260; sed -n 470,513p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-260; rg -n "FooterItem" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -name "FooterItem*.d.ts" | head

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; cat $N/index.d.ts | head -40; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; rg -n "interface LogoProps" -A 25 $N/components/types.d.ts; rg -n "renderFooter|renderContent" $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; sed -n 55,70p $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; rg -n "RenderContentType" -A3 $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts $N/components/types.d.ts | head; rg -n "FooterItem|AsideHeader\b" $N/components/index.d.ts; rg -n "onItemClick" -A2 $N/components/types.d.ts | head
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -2; curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo rc=$?; wc -l /tmp/uikit7.txt; head -5 /tmp/uikit7.txt

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $U | tr '\n' ' '; echo; for f in SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts Card/Card.d.ts Text/Text.d.ts Label/Label.d.ts; do echo "== $f"; cat $U/$f 2>/dev/null | head -60; done; rg -n "export type TextProps|variant|color" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "theme\?|RealTheme|Theme =" $U/theme/types.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n "interface ControlGroupProps|interface ControlGroupOption" -A14 $U/types.d.ts; rg -n "color\?" -B1 -A2 $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head; rg -n "TEXT_COLORS|colorText" $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; sed -n 1,40p $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | rg -n "'" | head -20; rg -n "export" $U/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts $U/theme/useTheme.d.ts; rg -n "interface FlexProps" -A30 $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | rg -n "gap|direction|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap" ; rg -n "Box|sp\b|spacing" $U/layout/index.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n "gap\?|wrap\?|spacing\?|width\?" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; I=node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; for n in House Gear CircleInfo Sun Moon ListUl ChartColumn LayoutCells Bell Person CircleCheck; do test -f $I/$n.js && echo "ok $n" || echo "MISSING $n"; done; ls $I | head -3

sed -i "s/import { Moon, Sun } from '@gravity-ui\/icons';/import { LayoutCells, Moon, Sun } from '@gravity-ui\/icons';/; s/icon: Sun, href: '#\/'/icon: LayoutCells, href: '#\/'/" src/App.tsx && grep -n "LayoutCells" src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
